_doc: Fixture manifest for the multi-zoom sets (testset/zoomset_*), added 2026-08-19.
These are the FIRST real multi-zoom captures the project has ever had: one full-spread
anchor plus 2-4 phone zoom close-ups of the same spread, shot with the Android app
(app-android/) over Wi-Fi and processed by the desktop server. Until now Stage 01's
multi-zoom stitch path had only synthetic unit tests -- DEVICE_SESSION.md goal 3.
They were shot handheld with the book on the photographer's lap, so 40-55% of each
frame is room (floor, desk, cables, chair). That is not a flaw in the fixture; it is
what a real capture looks like, and it is what broke Stage 02 on three of the four.
MEASURED ON ARRIVAL (docs/RESULTS.md 2026-08-19):
- Stage 01 stitched 0 of 11 close-ups. Every one was rejected by the min_inliers=25
gate. Raising ORB's feature budget 4000 -> 20000 (no other change) takes it to 4 of 11.
- Cropping the anchor to the book by hand, with the budget already raised, added
almost nothing (de_01_f01 15->16 inliers, de_01_f02 43->46). So the clutter hurts
the GUTTER SPLIT, not the stitch; the stitch was starved of features.
- The close-ups that still fail have their surviving inliers clustered in a small
patch of the frame (x-spread 0.2-0.4 of the width), which a single planar
homography cannot explain. Whether that is page curvature is OPEN.
- Stage 02 found the true spine on 1 of 4 spreads (zoomset_de_02).
NO GT of any kind yet. These are diagnostic fixtures, not graded ones.
Append-only, like every other testset entry.

zoomset_de_01.gutter_split: WRONG - gutter_x=2855/4080 landed on the book's right-hand OUTER edge, not the spine; left.png swallowed the whole spread (566 words), right.png was background (14 words)

zoomset_de_02.gutter_split: CORRECT - gutter_x=1631/4080 on the spine; both subpages OCR'd well (293 words @ conf 77.4 / 385 @ 73.7). This set is the CONTROL: it shows stages 03-06 are fine on real captures once the split is right

zoomset_en_01.book: Via ferrata guide (English), pp. 218-219 'The Via Ferrata Simone and the Via Ferrata dei 50'
zoomset_en_01.gutter_split: WRONG - gutter_x=1272/4080 landed in the background clutter left of the book; also the anchor was rotated 180 by an OSD call at conf 2.49 (just over the min_conf 2.0 gate) and the delivered page is upside down. Hardest set: book held tilted with a fanned page block, ~55% of the frame is room
